objective: Add list filtering to the todo service: GET /todos?done=true|false&tag=<t> returns only matching todos, with stable ordering and a deterministic 400 on malformed filter parameters.
in_scope: tag support on todos (string field, set at creation)

out_of_scope.item: notification of any kind (webhooks, email, in-app)
out_of_scope.reason: deferred to stage 2 — needs its own contract work
no request; API surface stays minimal

frozen_assumptions.statement: the service runs single-process with the in-memory store; no persistence layer is involved
frozen_assumptions.rationale: store.py holds everything in memory; the platform runs one replica

frozen_architecture.decision: TodoAPI is the only writer to the store; handlers never mutate store state directly
frozen_architecture.rationale: keeps the API layer testable and the store the single source of truth

shared_contracts.spec: GET /todos response: {todos: [{id: string, title: string, done: boolean, tag?: string}]} — exactly these keys per todo, in creation order; 400 {error} on malformed filter params
shared_contracts.unfreeze_rule: only via a contract change request with product sign-off; external clients depend on the exact key set

shared_contracts.spec: todo record shape in store: {id: 't<n>', title: string, done: boolean, tag?: string}; creation order preserved
shared_contracts.unfreeze_rule: additive-only until stage 2 proposes otherwise in writing

integration_seams.description: handler -> store boundary: every read/write goes through TodoStore methods

acceptance.description: GET /todos?done=true returns only done todos; ?done=false only undone; both in creation order
acceptance.positive_case: 3 todos (2 done, 1 open): ?done=true yields exactly the 2 done todos in creation order

acceptance.description: tag filter matches exact tag; todos without a tag never match a tag filter
acceptance.positive_case: todos with tag=work and one untagged: ?tag=work yields only the tagged ones
acceptance.negative_case: ?tag=work when no todo has that tag yields {todos: []}
acceptance.failure_behavior: no match is a valid empty result, not an error

constraints.rule: stdlib only; no new third-party imports

stages.objective: stage 2: notifications on completion (see product ticket)

stage_boundary.because: filtering is acceptance-verifiable end to end after T02; notifications are a separate stage with its own contract work
expected_new_evidence: stage-1 tests green under the frozen suite
